qualification: firsthand K7222 repairer-reported operating comparator; revision and measurement method unspecified, not a K7222.11 factory winding ratio

source.author: RP
source.context: Repairer describes substituting three TV flyback transformers in K7222 monitors, reports no monitor readjustment in those trials, and compares TV collector pulses with K7222 collector pulse and EHT ranges.
source.limits: The post does not identify a .11 board, state how the voltages were measured, or separate original from replacement-transformer operating values.

derived_effective_amplitude_ratio.equation: EHT DC voltage / collector flyback pulse amplitude; endpoints use the lowest EHT with highest pulse and highest EHT with lowest pulse
derived_effective_amplitude_ratio.interpretation: This is an external effective voltage ratio with rectifier, loading and winding-baseline effects. It is not a measured turns ratio.

comparison_to_active_hypothesis.limits: The active 64 drive turns, tap graph, collector-pulse transfer and source revision remain unverified. The effective voltage range cannot alone select or freeze a turn count.
